subject: Draft MAP: close runway & procurement gating (signature cutoff proposal)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@lundr.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP: close runway & procurement gating (signature cutoff proposal)

Tom —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time and for walking us through Lundr's rollout priorities. Per our call, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed and a suggested ownership split. Key asks below so we can lock the target close date: 

Suggested high-level timeline (proposal):
- Target close (contract signed + PO issued): 2026-07-29
- Procurement signature cutoff (to make your July fiscal window): 2026-07-22

Draft milestones (included in attached PDF):
1) Security questionnaire + SOC2 packet delivered (owner: Redwood SOC) — target 2026-06-25
2) Technical POC / sandbox validation (owner: Lundr engineering) — target 2026-07-08
3) Commercial review & SOW finalization (owner: Lundr legal + Redwood AE) — target 2026-07-15
4) Contract signature & PO issuance (owner: Lundr procurement/legal) — target 2026-07-29 (signature cutoff: 2026-07-22)
5) SSO / SAML setup and onboarding (owner: Lundr platform + Redwood CS) — target 2026-08-06

Dependencies we flagged on the call: SOC2 evidence, internal budget sign-off in your system, and final SOW attachment. If your procurement team needs an earlier internal deadline for paperwork, let us know and we can nudge items earlier on our side.

Ask: Can you please confirm by end of day Wed 2026-06-23:
- Who will own each milestone on the Lundr side (name + email),
- Whether procurement can sign by 2026-07-22 (or the latest acceptable date),
- Any gating items we missed that will block a July close.

Attachments: Lundr_MAP_DRAFT_v1.pdf, SOW_outline_v0.3.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min follow up if easier.

—
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126

--Attachment: Lundr_MAP_DRAFT_v1.pdf (PDF, 94 KB)
--Attachment: SOW_outline_v0.3.xlsx (XLSX, 28 KB)
From: Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@lundr.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@lundr.com>, Lundr Procurement <procurement@lundr.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 16:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: close runway & procurement gating (signature cutoff proposal)

Priya,

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on the MAP. A couple of notes from procurement here that will affect the signature runway: 

- Our fiscal month-end is 2026-07-31. For deals to be reflected in the July close, legal + procurement need the contract and PO with signatures no later than 2026-07-22 to allow for approvals and AP processing (we typically need ~6-7 business days).
- Sarah Patel (copied) is our procurement lead; she'll be the approver for PO issuance.
- We also require the SOC2 type II report (or equivalently our questionnaire satisfactorily completed) before legal will approve. Can Redwood provide the SOC2 packet and a contact for the security reviewer?

If we can't hit the 7/22 signature cutoff, we may be pushed into the August close — which will shift runway for product and budget. There's no technical blocker from our side if Redwood can meet the SOC2 and SSO checklist dates you proposed.

I'll loop Sarah directly on the next message; she can advise on whether exceptions are possible.

Best,
Tom
Director of Product Operations | Lundr
tom.hargreaves@lundr.com

--Forwarded attachment request: Please provide SOC2 packet + security contact
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@lundr.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: close runway & procurement gating (signature cutoff proposal)

Team and Tom —

Thanks for the clarity on procurement timing. To keep Lundr inside the July fiscal window we should tighten some internal deliveries and commit to a signature cutoff of 2026-07-22 as Tom suggested. Proposed actions from Redwood: 

- Security: I'll share the SOC2 pack and a short answers summary by EOD Mon 2026-06-22. (Attachment: MAP_v1.1_redlines.pdf shows what we'll include.)
- Engineering: Dev, can you confirm the SSO checklist timeline? If we can provide the SAML metadata and onboarding guide within 48 hours of the POC sign-off (target 2026-07-09), that should keep integration work on-track.
- Commercial: Ben, I'll need you to own SOW finalization with Lundr legal and track signoffs so procurement has a single PDF to approve.

Updated target dates (Redwood commits):
- SOC2 packet & answers summary: 2026-06-22
- SSO onboarding guide & metadata: 2026-07-10
- Finalized SOW delivered to Lundr legal: 2026-07-15
- Signature cutoff (Redwood asks Lundr to sign by): 2026-07-22

If Lundr confirms owner names for the milestones we can update the MAP and send v1.1 to legal. Tom — if Sarah can give a hard confirmation on the 7/22 cutoff, we'll escalate the SOW and SOC2 priorities internally.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

--Attachment: MAP_v1.1_redlines.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)
From: Tom Hargreaves <tom.hargreaves@lundr.com>

Marissa / Priya —

This all makes sense. Sarah confirms procurement will prioritize the review; 7/22 is the latest safe cutoff for our July close. We'll try to accelerate earlier if possible. Our milestone owners on the Lundr side:
- Security / questionnaire: Michael Lowe (michael.lowe@lundr.com)
- Engineering / POC: Aisha Rahman (aisha.r@lundr.com)
- Legal / SOW: Carlos Mendes (carlos.mendes@lundr.com)
- Procurement / PO: Sarah Patel (sarah.patel@lundr.com)

I'll have Sarah reach out directly to Ben for PO templates and to Priya for any procurement language. If Redwood can get SOC2 + SSO guide by the dates above, we're aligned on target close 2026-07-29 with signature cutoff 2026-07-22.

Regards,
Tom
